_comment: Workspace registry for the standalone kinetic. Copy to workspaces.json to enable named multi-workspace selection. The DEFAULT workspace (the engine's config.json-derived target) is ALWAYS available even without this file, so the engine runs standalone with zero registry. Each entry needs only `root`; every other field falls back to a safe engine default (see autopilot/lib/workspace.mjs → workspaceFromEntry). Select one at runtime with: node autopilot/cli.mjs --workspace <id> <command>, or list them with: node autopilot/cli.mjs workspaces. RushPoint is intentionally listed as just ONE entry here — it is not the engine's identity.
